caption: The drawing depicts a single wine glass centered on a plain, light beige background. The bowl of the glass is deep red with a transparent quality, featuring an etched or cut pattern consisting of circular and oval shapes as well as petal-like designs that reveal clear glass beneath the red surface. The stem of the glass is clear and transparent with a faceted, bell-shaped design that curves inward and then flares outward at the top and bottom. The base of the glass is clear, circular, and flat, with concentric patterns that suggest the reflection and refraction of light. There are no other objects or elements present in the drawing.
title: Ruby Case-Glass Goblet
